mechanism: Valproic acid inhibits UDP-glucuronosyltransferase (UGT1A1), the primary enzyme responsible for raltegravir glucuronidation, leading to increased raltegravir concentrations.
action: Monitor raltegravir plasma concentrations and clinical response; consider raltegravir dose adjustment if needed, or use alternative antiretroviral therapy if valproic acid cannot be discontinued.
